title: Keto Smoky Pork Skillet
description: A smoky, charred, and savory keto skillet dish featuring pork and a medley of spices.

ingredients.name: Skillet Charred Onions (see notes)
ingredients.notes: charred in a skillet over medium heat until caramelized

instructions: Heat a cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced pork to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes per side, or until browned.
Remove the pork from the skillet and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add the smoked paprika and garlic powder to the skillet.
Add the skillet charred onions to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the pork to the skillet and stir to coat with the onion and spice mixture.
Serve the pork hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.
